bodyHtml:
MEGA-60 High-Pressure Booster Tank

60-Liter (14 Gallon) 16-Bar Pressure Tank for High-Rise & Long-Distance Water Systems | Aquasky MEGA-PLUS Series | Made in Taiwan

MEGA-60 is a pressurized water system component designed for high-rise buildings, fire systems, and demanding long-distance pressure support. With a 60-liter (14-gallon) capacity, it reliably maintains water pressure at a set, consistent level.

 

Built for high-stress environments, this tank supports a robust maximum operating pressure of 16 bar. It is factory pre-charged with 100% nitrogen gas to ensure stable performance and prevent pressure fluctuations caused by temperature changes.

 

Measuring 39.0 cm in diameter and 60.7 cm in height, the tank includes a heavy-duty base for added stability. It is an ideal high-capacity solution for residential and commercial booster setups requiring exceptional high-pressure performance and flow rates.

Price InquiryContact us

Product Overview

The MEGA-60 is a 60-liter (16-gallon) high-performance diaphragm tank, engineered as the premier solution for residential water system stabilization. Utilizing a specialized FDA-grade polypropylene liner integrated with a premium butyl diaphragm, it ensures a dedicated "Safe Water Zone" by preventing any contact between the liquid and the tank's metallic shell.

Key technical advantages include a 100% Nitrogen pre-charge and a 16-bar (232 PSI) pressure rating, which significantly outperforms standard industry tanks. This configuration ensures more stable pressure cycles and minimizes pump "short-cycling," directly preventing motor burnout and extending equipment lifespan. 

Constructed with a heavy-duty cold-rolled carbon steel shell and protected by a triple-grade epoxy powder finish, the MEGA-60 offers superior oxidation resistance. Equipped with a premium 1” Stainless Steel lead-free connector, this CE and ISO 9001 certified unit provides an energy-saving, maintenance-free solution for critical high-pressure applications.

Key Features & Design Advantages

  • 16-Bar high-pressure rating for high-rise buildings and long-distance pipelines.
  • Cold rolled carbon steel shell offers exceptional structural integrity under extreme pressure.
  • 304 stainless steel connection ensures secure, rust-free, durable integration.
  • Heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm withstands frequent cycling and maintains constant pressure.
  • Triple-grade blue paint coating provides superior exterior protection.
  • 100% Nitrogen pre-charged to prevent pressure loss common with compressed air.
  • 100% made in Taiwan.

How the MEGA-PLUS Pressure Tank Works

The MEGA-60 stores supplemental water between the liner and the heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm. When a faucet is opened or an appliance demands water, the compressed nitrogen air chamber pushes the stored water into the system. This allows the system to meet low-volume water demands without immediately triggering the pump motor. By creating this efficient supply cycle, the tank minimizes pump cycling, stabilizes water pressure, and conserves energy.

Key benefits

  • Provides ideal high-pressure delivery for high-rise buildings and long-distance applications
  • Extends equipment life by reducing pump starts and preventing motor burnout
  • Guarantees robust, stable water flow for showers, washers, and dishwashers
  • Zero maintenance required, saving time and servicing costs

Typical Applications

  • High-rise building water supply networks
  • Long-distance water pressure support systems
  • Fire systems and water machining (10L per min flow rate applications)
  • Residential and commercial booster pump systems
  • Appliance water pressure stabilization (washing machines, dishwashers)

Frequently Asked Question (FAQ)

Q1 : How does the MEGA-60 ensure maximum structural safety before leaving the factory?

Every single MEGA-60 tank is 100% pressure tested before shipping, ensuring it can safely handle its aggressive 16-Bar rating in the field.
 

Q2 : What is the flow rate capacity of the MEGA-60, and what prevents it from rusting internally?

The MEGA-60 supports a 10L per minute flow rate. Internal rusting is prevented by a polypropylene liner and a DIN 4807-regulated diaphragm that completely isolate the water from the carbon steel tank body to create a safe water zone.

Q3 : What international certifications does the MEGA-60 hold?

The MEGA-60 is fully certified by CE and ISO9001.
